Calcutta High Court directs CPI(M) to set up bookstalls during Kali Puja

The Calcutta High Court has directed the Communist Party of India (Marxist) to set up bookstalls during the Kali Puja festival. This directive comes after the party was reportedly denied permission to set up stalls during the Durga Puja festivities.
